scoring_justification: Checker recomputes the generalized additivity integral with root-finding to compute expected start temperatures, comparing agent’s values within tolerance.

hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper equations and parameters (tau_in, S(T), Newtonian cooling)
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are deterministic output of the paper's formulas; no fabricated random labels.

outputs.description: Computed transformation start temperatures for ten cooling rates. The checker independently recomputes T_start_generalized for each alpha using the same formulas and numerical integration, and compares within a tolerance.

output_contract.notes: The generalized rule uses S(T)=1.083−0.00106·T. The traditional rule uses S=1. The file must have exactly ten rows; no header.

steps.description: Recompute generalized start temperatures using paper formulas and compare each row.
